question: Where can I find restaurant that lies within 170 kilometers en route to Charlottesville and Albemarle County Courthouse Historic District, Charlottesville, VA from Heavenly Heart Farm & Mini Petting Zoo, Edinburg, VA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.658874 38.840265)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.480321 38.031339)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.658874 38.840265)',4326)::geography, 170000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.658874 38.840265)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
